blocks.html:
Characters, numbers and symbols shall contrast with the background on which they are displayed at a ratio of 4.5:1 (relative illuminance). The background shall be solid and static.
   Exception: Information unrelated to floor levels and their selection shall not be required to comply with Section 1109.7.2.2.3.1.
